meta.title: Human Resource Policy | Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation

title: Our Policy
heading: Human Resource Policy
lead: Establishing professional standards, ethical practices, and an inclusive workplace culture for sustainable organizational growth.

introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
introduction.p1: The Human Resource (HR) Policy of Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation establishes the principles, standards, and procedures for recruiting, developing, managing, and retaining employees while promoting a professional, ethical, and inclusive work environment.
introduction.p2: This policy applies to all permanent employees, contractual staff, probationary employees, temporary staff, consultants, interns, volunteers, and field staff working with the Foundation.

vision.heading: 2. Vision
vision.p1: To build a motivated, skilled, ethical, and service-oriented workforce committed to financial inclusion, community development, and creating a positive social impact.

mission.heading: 3. Mission
mission.p1: The Human Resource department aims to create a supportive workplace by focusing on:

list1.promotingEqualEmployment: Promoting equal employment opportunities for all.
list1.ensuringEmployeeWelfare: Ensuring employee welfare, growth, and development.
list1.maintainingSafeRespectful: Maintaining a safe, respectful, and inclusive workplace environment.

coreValues.heading: 4. Core Values
coreValues.p1: The Foundation follows strong values that guide employee behavior, organizational culture, and community service:

equalEmployment.heading: 5. Equal Employment Opportunity
equalEmployment.p1: The Foundation provides equal employment opportunities without discrimination based on:
equalEmployment.p2: Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and organizational needs.

recruitmentSelection.heading: 6. Recruitment & Selection
recruitmentSelection.p1: Recruitment shall be conducted fairly and transparently.

probation.heading: 8. Probation
probation.p1: New employees may be placed on probation for up to 3 months, subject to the terms of their appointment letter. Confirmation of employment will be based on satisfactory performance.

workingHours.heading: 9. Working Hours
workingHours.p1: Note:- Field staff may follow different schedules based on operational requirements.

attendance.heading: 10. Attendance

list1.informSupervisorsRegarding: Inform supervisors regarding delay or absence

attendance.p2: Unauthorized absence may result in disciplinary action.

leavePolicy.heading: 11. Leave Policy

list1.paternityLeaveAdopted: Paternity Leave (if adopted by the Foundation)

leavePolicy.p2: Leave must be approved before availing except in emergency situations.

salaryBenefits.heading: 12. Salary & Benefits
salaryBenefits.p2: Salary payments are normally processed through bank transfer.

confidentiality.heading: 15. Confidentiality
confidentiality.p2: Confidentiality obligations remain applicable even after employment ends.

performanceManagement.p1: Performance shall be reviewed periodically based on:

healthSafety.p1: The Foundation is committed to providing:
healthSafety.p2: Employees are expected to follow all workplace safety guidelines.

resignation.heading: 20. Resignation
resignation.p1: Employees intending to resign must submit a written resignation and complete the notice period mentioned in their appointment letter unless waived by the Foundation.

termination.heading: 21. Termination
termination.p1: Employment may be terminated under the following circumstances:
termination.p2: The Foundation will follow applicable legal requirements.

grievanceRedressal.heading: 22. Grievance Redressal
grievanceRedressal.p1: Employees may raise workplace concerns through the HR Department or designated authority.
grievanceRedressal.p2: All grievances will be handled fairly, confidentially, and without retaliation.

compliance.heading: 23. Compliance
compliance.p2: Where the Foundation carries out regulated financial activities, employees must also comply with all applicable regulatory requirements.

policyAmendments.heading: 24. Policy Amendments
policyAmendments.p1: Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation reserves the right to review and update this HR Policy whenever required to meet organizational and regulatory needs.
policyAmendments.p2: Any revised policy updates will be communicated to all employees through appropriate channels.
